_notes: The entrypoint runs migrations + seeds (idempotent) and then intel.schedule on every start.
cronSchedule is UTC: 04:30 and 05:30 UTC both fire; intel.schedule runs only the firing that is 05:30 Europe/London (BST vs GMT) and exits otherwise.
One-off smoke run: temporarily set the start command to `/app/pipeline/entrypoint.sh python -m intel.schedule --force --no-wait`, redeploy, then remove it.

Required variables: DATABASE_URL, ANTHROPIC_API_KEY, OPERATOR_EMAIL, MD_EMAIL, EXECUTION_MODE (shadow until M8), GRAPH_TENANT_ID, GRAPH_CLIENT_ID, GRAPH_CLIENT_SECRET, GRAPH_SENDER (or GRAPH_REFRESH_TOKEN for delegated auth), APP_BASE_URL, PDF_STORAGE_DIR (a mounted volume until object storage is wired).
No secret is stored in this repository.
